title: Multi-file feature: due dates for a todo CLI

steps.request: Add due dates to the todo CLI. `todo add "Pay rent" --due 2026-12-01` should store the due date (YYYY-MM-DD). `todo list` should show `(due 2026-12-01)` after the title, and `OVERDUE` at the end of the line for tasks that aren't done and whose due date is before today. Add `todo list --overdue` to show only those overdue tasks. An invalid date (like 2026-13-40 or 'tomorrow') must be rejected: print a message to stderr, exit with code 1, and save nothing. Today's date comes from the TODO_TODAY environment variable (YYYY-MM-DD) when it's set, so it can be tested. Keep the existing commands and output working, and add tests.

acceptance: add --due stores a valid YYYY-MM-DD date; invalid dates exit 1 with a stderr message and nothing is saved
list shows (due DATE) and OVERDUE for undone tasks due before today (TODO_TODAY)
list --overdue filters to overdue undone tasks
Tasks without due dates print exactly as before
npm test passes with new tests
